title: Counting to 120
description: Count forward from any number to 120, complete missing-number sequences, work with numbers 101 to 120, and explore number patterns past 100.
learningFocus: Count forward to 120 from any number, read and write numbers 101 to 120, and complete missing-number sequences and a 101 to 120 chart.
adultGuidance: Have your child say each number aloud while writing, especially across 99 to 101 and 109 to 111; count a short stretch together if needed, then let them continue. Page 4 is optional enrichment beyond 1.NBT.A.1, and the separate answer key is for adults only.
